questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical understanding of end-to-end image provenance in CNF multi-tenant contexts, combining signing, SBOM, and policy.

## Key Concepts
- Cosign signing with KMS-backed key
- SBOM generation/attachment
- Tenant-scoped image labeling
- Kyverno policy for signature/SBOM/label enforcement

## Code Example
```yaml
# Kyverno policy (simplified)
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-provenance
spec:
  validationFailureAction: enforce
  rules:
  - name: verify-signature-and-sbom
    match:
      resources:
        kinds: [Deployment]
    validate:
      message: "Image must be signed and SBOM attached with tenant label"
      pattern:
        spec:
          template:
            spec:
              containers:
              - image: ?
```
```bash
# Cosign signing (example)
cosign sign --key kms://my-kms/key registry/tenant/image:tag
syft registry/tenant/image:tag -o cyclonedx-json > sbom.json
cosign attach sbom registry/tenant/image:tag < sbom.json
```

- How would you rotate signing keys with minimal downtime?
- How to test cross-tenant leakage in this setup?

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design tenant-scoped upgrades, maintain isolation, and implement progressive release with concrete mechanisms.

## Key Concepts
- Kubernetes CRDs and multi-tenant mapping
- Canary rollouts and traffic splitting (Istio/Linkerd)
- Namespace-scoped isolation and rollback strategies
- Observability: SLIs for upgrade safety

## Code Example
```yaml
# Tenant CRD (simplified)
apiVersion: apiextensions.k8s.io/v1
kind: CustomResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: tenants.cnf.example.com
spec:
  group: cnf.example.com
  versions:
  - name: v1
    served: true
    storage: true
    schema:
      openAPIV3Schema:
        type: object
        properties:
          spec:
            type: object
            properties:
              tenantID: { type: string }
              namespace: { type: string }
              desiredVersion: { type: string }
  scope: Cluster
  names:
    plural: tenants
    singular: tenant
    kind: Tenant
    shortNames: [ tns ]
```

```yaml
# Tenant canary Deployment (tenant-a)
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: cnf-gateway
        tenant: tenant-a
        version: v2
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: gateway
        image: registry.example/cnf/gateway:v2
```

```yaml
# Istio TrafficSplit example for canary (tenant-a)
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: cnf-gateway
  namespace: tenant-a
spec:
  http:
  - route:
    - destination:
        host: cnf-gateway.tenant-a.svc.cluster.local
        subset: v1
      weight: 90
    - destination:
        host: cnf-gateway.tenant-a.svc.cluster.local
        subset: v2
      weight: 10
```

```yaml
      names:
        kind: K8sTenantAccess
  targets:
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to implement multi-tenant zero-trust mTLS using SPIFFE IDs, short-lived cert rotation, and KMS-backed CA in CNF gateways.

## Key Concepts
- SPIFFE/SPIRE trust domains per tenant
- CSR-based certificate rotation with short lifetimes
- Per-tenant mesh policies (Istio/OPA) for north-south and east-west traffic
- Workload identity verification via SPIFFE IDs

## Code Example
```yaml
# CSR bootstrap (outline)
apiVersion: certificates.k8s.io/v1
kind: CertificateSigningRequest
metadata:
  name: gateway-td1-csr
spec:
  signerName: kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-clientSigner
  request: <base64-csr>
  usages:
  - digital signature
  - key encipherment
  - client auth
```
